custom_app.field_category_help: Select the most relevant category for this app. This helps with visual organization and filtering.
custom_app.field_icon_help: Pick an icon shown on the app card.
custom_app.no_ports: No port mappings — the app won't be accessible from a browser.
custom_app.ports_range_note: Host ports should be in the 8600+ range. Custom apps get ports starting at {{port}}.
custom_app.no_volumes: No volumes — data won't persist across restarts.
custom_app.resource_limits_help: Caps prevent a runaway container from starving the host. Leave blank to use the defaults (1024 MB / 1 CPU).
custom_app.port_in_use_msg: Currently bound by: {{usedBy}}. Installation may fail.
custom_app.restart_policy_note: Containers are created with --restart=unless-stopped. Data is not persisted unless you add volume mounts above.
